<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="company" name="Company" processRef="audit-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="audit-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="management" name="Company management">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>schedule</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="internal" name="Internal teams">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>prepare</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gather</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>selfassess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>correct</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="auditors" name="External auditors">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>identify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>finalaudit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>criteria</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>award</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>issue</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_denied</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Compliance audit needed" />
    <bpmn:task id="schedule" name="Schedule compliance audit" />
    <bpmn:task id="prepare" name="Prepare documentation" />
    <bpmn:task id="gather" name="Gather evidence" />
    <bpmn:task id="selfassess" name="Conduct self-assessment" />
    <bpmn:task id="review" name="Review the company's processes" />
    <bpmn:task id="identify" name="Identify gaps or issues" />
    <bpmn:task id="correct" name="Make necessary corrections or improvements" />
    <bpmn:task id="finalaudit" name="Undergo final audit" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="criteria" name="All criteria met?" />
    <bpmn:task id="award" name="Award certification" />
    <bpmn:task id="issue" name="Issue official documents" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_done" name="Process concluded" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_denied" name="Certification not awarded" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="schedule" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="schedule" targetRef="prepare" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="prepare" targetRef="gather" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="gather" targetRef="selfassess" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="selfassess" targetRef="review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="review" targetRef="identify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="identify" targetRef="correct" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="correct" targetRef="finalaudit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="finalaudit" targetRef="criteria" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" name="yes" sourceRef="criteria" targetRef="award" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" name="no" sourceRef="criteria" targetRef="end_denied" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="award" targetRef="issue" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="issue" targetRef="end_done" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
